'''N'haz Mit''' was a wanted criminal who was tracked down and killed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Necropolis]] by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. A short time later, Mit was alive again, likely due to Dr. [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan's]] experiments pertaining to [[Project Starscream]]. Fett then returned to the planet and killed him a second time.<ref name="GOF" />

==Behind the scenes==
"N'haz Mit" is [[Timothy Zahn|Tim Zahn]] spelled backward.<ref name="GOF" />
